# Form 17 revenue control — demo

A working screen that reconciles each service against its Form 17 authorization
(טופס 17), the claim, the payment and the commercial contract, and shows a
collections clerk what happened in each case, in order.

**The data is synthetic.** It is generated by a seeded script and contains no
real patient, hospital or HMO records. It is not Assuta data and not any real
HMO's data. The page says so in its own header.

- `index.html` — the screen (Hebrew, RTL)
- `data.js` — the exported fixture: 902 episodes, 11 leakage families

Published at https://shabtai.github.io/form17-revenue-control-demo/

Built from a private fixture repo: a seeded generator, deterministic laws, no
model and no network at the point the numbers are produced.
